provenance: Eight selected historical ZIPs supplied by h0p3; this is not a complete development history.
record_status: New curatorial manifest reconstructed from unchanged source ZIPs on 2026-10-06; not the exact missing earlier manifest.

preservation.original_zips: Unchanged bytes; all original ZIP metadata remains available in each ZIP.
preservation.file_members: Every regular file member retains its original path beneath the version contents directory and exact bytes.
preservation.git_modes: 100755 when any carried executable bit is set; otherwise100644. Git does not preserve the full ZIP mode, owner, timestamp or xattrs.
preservation.directories: Explicit directory entries are recorded here. Git cannot represent empty directories alone. No synthetic file is inserted into source contents.
preservation.chronology: ZIP timestamps and source version stamps are carried claims, not authenticated chronology.
preservation.execution: No uploaded program or historical work order was executed during curation.
preservation.rights: Carried notices remain applicable. No new blanket license is granted.
